name.zh: 大颗柬埔寨蓝宝石垫形切割 14.69克拉

description.zh: 这颗华丽的柬埔寨蓝宝石拥有深邃的蓝色调，垫形切割展现出迷人的火彩和亮度。
description.en: This gorgeous Cambodian sapphire features a deep blue hue with cushion cut displaying captivating fire and brilliance.

name.zh: 明亮黄色蓝宝石无热处理 1.31克拉

description.zh: 天然未经热处理的黄色蓝宝石，色彩明亮饱满，极为稀有珍贵。
description.en: Natural unheated yellow sapphire with bright, saturated color. Extremely rare and precious.

name.zh: 鲜艳非洲石榴石玫瑰红 3.08克拉

description.zh: 来自非洲的石榴石，呈现出独特的玫瑰红色调，火彩绚丽。
description.en: African garnet displaying a unique rose red hue with spectacular fire.

name.zh: 大颗紫色坦桑石垫形 22.49克拉

description.zh: 极为稀有的大颗紫色坦桑石，垫形切割完美展现其三色性。
description.en: Extremely rare large purple tanzanite with cushion cut perfectly showcasing its trichroism.

name.zh: 椭圆形巴西莫桑比克莫桑石 10.38克拉

description.zh: 来自巴西的精选莫桑石，温暖的桃粉色调令人沉醉。
description.en: Selected Brazilian morganite with an enchanting warm peach-pink tone.

name.zh: 天然坦桑石垫形切割 3.20克拉

description.zh: 优质天然坦桑石，垫形切割展现迷人的蓝紫色调。限量稀有款。
description.en: Premium natural tanzanite with cushion cut displaying enchanting blue-violet hue. Limited rare edition.

name.zh: 天然碧玺双色 刚果 6.59克拉

description.zh: 来自刚果的天然双色碧玺，独特的色彩渐变令人惊叹。
description.en: Natural bicolor tourmaline from Congo with stunning unique color gradation.

description.zh: 天然红色尖晶石，色彩浓郁深邃，品质出众。
description.en: Natural red spinel with rich, deep color and outstanding quality.

name.zh: 鲜艳黄色蓝宝石无热处理 1.51克拉

description.zh: 未经热处理的天然黄色蓝宝石，明亮耀眼。
description.en: Natural unheated yellow sapphire, brilliantly radiant.

description.zh: 来自哥伦比亚的顶级祖母绿，鲜艳的绿色令人叹为观止，净度出众。
description.en: Top-quality Colombian emerald with breathtaking vivid green color and exceptional clarity.

description.zh: 产自斯里兰卡的经典皇家蓝蓝宝石，色泽纯正，切割完美。
description.en: Classic royal blue sapphire from Sri Lanka with pure color and perfect cut.

description.zh: 缅甸鸽血红红宝石，世界上最珍贵的宝石之一，色泽浓郁鲜艳。
description.en: Burmese pigeon blood ruby, one of the world's most precious gems with rich, vivid color.
